candidates.description: This feature vector activates on tokens related to problems, difficulties, and questions across multiple languages.
This vector represents structural or functional system components and methodologies.
This feature vector activates on concepts, terminology, and sub-word tokens associated with cognitive ability, artificial intelligence, and intelligence agencies or personnel.
This vector represents the concept of utilization and the act of using something across various languages and grammatical forms.
These tokens represent modal verbs denoting ability, possibility, or obligation across various European languages.
This feature vector represents data and information-related nouns across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents adverbial intensifiers and quantifiers used to modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs across multiple languages.
This vector is related to German auxiliary and modal verbs indicating tense, mood, or voice.
This feature vector represents the concept of scale, degree, and specificity modifiers used to emphasize the magnitude or exactness of a noun or condition.
This vector represents personal computing devices, operating systems, and related software technology.
